statBlock.name: Dao
statBlock.description: An earth genie that glides through unworked stone and bargains for gems, metalwork, or fossils.

sections.Traits:
Earth Glide. The dao can burrow through unworked, nonmagical earth and stone without disturbing it.
Elemental Restoration. If the genie dies outside the Elemental Plane of Earth, its body dissolves into dirt. It returns at full HP in a new body somewhere on that plane after 1d4 days.
Magic Resistance. Roll saving throws against spells and other magical effects with Advantage.
Wishes. Roll a 30 percent chance that this genie knows Wish. It can cast the spell solely on behalf of a non-genie who expresses a wish it understands. Casting this way causes the genie no stress from the spell. After three castings, it must wait 365 days before casting Wish again.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Earthen Maul attacks or two Earth Burst attacks.
Earthen Maul. Melee attack, +10 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 20 (4d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage and knocks a Large or smaller creature Prone.
Earth Burst. Ranged attack, +10 to hit, range 120 ft. A hit deals 15 (2d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage. Hit or miss, a blast erupts from the target's space. The target and each other creature in the 10-ft. Emanation centered there make a DC 16 Dexterity save. A failed save deals 10 (3d6) thunder damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
Spellcasting. As an action, cast one listed spell with Charisma and no Material components. Spell save DC 16.
At will. Detect Evil and Good, Detect Magic, Stone Shape.
1/day each. Gaseous Form, Invisibility, Move Earth, Passwall, Plane Shift, Tongues, Wall of Stone.

statBlock.name: Djinni
statBlock.description: An air genie that roams stormy coasts and cloud palaces. It may trade stories for lore from other worlds.

sections.Traits:
Elemental Restoration. If the genie dies outside the Elemental Plane of Air, its body dissolves into mist. It returns at full HP in a new body somewhere on that plane after 1d4 days.
Magic Resistance. Roll saving throws against spells and other magical effects with Advantage.
Wishes. Roll a 30 percent chance that this genie knows Wish. It can cast the spell solely on behalf of a non-genie who expresses a wish it understands. Casting this way causes the genie no stress from the spell. After three castings, it must wait 365 days before casting Wish again.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three attacks using any mix of Storm Blade and Storm Bolt.
Storm Blade. Melee attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) lightning damage.
Storm Bolt. Ranged attack, +9 to hit, range 120 ft. A hit deals 13 (3d8) thunder damage and knocks a Large or smaller creature Prone.
Create Whirlwind. Choose a visible point within 120 ft. The whirlwind fills a 20-ft.-radius, 60-ft.-high Cylinder at that point and lasts until the djinni's Concentration ends. At the start of each of its turns, the djinni can move the whirlwind up to 20 ft. When a creature enters the whirlwind or the whirlwind enters its space, it makes a DC 17 Strength save, at most once per turn. The djinni is unaffected. On a failure, the target is Restrained while in the whirlwind and moves with it. While Restrained this way, it takes 21 (6d6) thunder damage at the start of each of its turns and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns. Success ends the effect on that creature.
sections.Spellcasting:
Spellcasting. As an action, cast one listed spell with Charisma and no Material components. Spell save DC 17.
At will. Detect Evil and Good, Detect Magic.
2/day each. Create Food and Water (can make wine instead of water), Tongues, Wind Walk.
1/day each. Creation, Gaseous Form, Invisibility, Major Image, Plane Shift.

statBlock.name: Efreeti
statBlock.description: A fire genie that can fight with a burning blade or hurl flame from a distance.

sections.Traits:
Elemental Restoration. If the genie dies outside the Elemental Plane of Fire, its body dissolves into ash. It returns at full HP in a new body somewhere on that plane after 1d4 days.
Magic Resistance. Roll saving throws against spells and other magical effects with Advantage.
Wishes. Roll a 30 percent chance that this genie knows Wish. It can cast the spell solely on behalf of a non-genie who expresses a wish it understands. Casting this way causes the genie no stress from the spell. After three castings, it must wait 365 days before casting Wish again.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three attacks using any mix of Heated Blade and Hurl Flame.
Heated Blade. Melee attack, +10 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage plus 13 (2d12) fire damage.
Hurl Flame. Ranged attack, +8 to hit, range 120 ft. A hit deals 24 (7d6) fire damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
Spellcasting. As an action, cast one listed spell with Charisma and no Material components. Spell save DC 16.
At will. Detect Magic, Elementalism.
1/day each. Gaseous Form, Invisibility, Major Image, Plane Shift, Tongues, Wall of Fire (level 7).

statBlock.name: Marid
statBlock.description: A water genie at home on coasts and beneath the waves. It can hide in mist and knock enemies back with a jet of water.

sections.Traits:
Amphibious. The marid breathes air and water.
Elemental Restoration. If the genie dies outside the Elemental Plane of Water, its body dissolves into brine. It returns at full HP in a new body somewhere on that plane after 1d4 days.
Wishes. Roll a 30 percent chance that this genie knows Wish. It can cast the spell solely on behalf of a non-genie who expresses a wish it understands. Casting this way causes the genie no stress from the spell. After three castings, it must wait 365 days before casting Wish again.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Aquatic Lash attacks.
Aquatic Lash. Melee attack, +10 to hit, reach 15 ft. A hit deals 15 (2d8 + 6) slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) cold damage.
Water Jet. Each creature in a 60-ft.-long, 10-ft.-wide Line makes a DC 18 Dexterity save. Failure deals 31 (9d6) cold damage. A Huge or smaller creature that fails also falls Prone and can be pushed up to 20 ft. straight away from the marid. Success halves the damage and avoids the other effects.
sections.Spellcasting:
Spellcasting. As an action, cast one listed spell with Charisma and no Material components. Spell save DC 16.
At will. Create or Destroy Water, Detect Evil and Good, Detect Magic, Purify Food and Drink.
1/day each. Control Water, Gaseous Form, Invisibility, Plane Shift, Tongues.
sections.Bonus actions: Misty Veil (recharge 5–6). Cast Fog Cloud using Charisma, as in Spellcasting.
sections.Habitats: Coasts, Elemental Plane of Water, underwater.

statBlock.name: Deva
statBlock.description: A divine messenger that takes the form of a beast or a winged mortal. It often gives mortals something to deliver on its behalf.

sections.Traits:
Exalted Restoration. If the angel dies away from Mount Celestia, its body vanishes and it immediately returns at full HP in a new body somewhere on Mount Celestia.
Magic Resistance. Roll saving throws against spells and other magical effects with Advantage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Holy Mace attacks.
Holy Mace. Melee attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) radiant damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
Spellcasting. As an action, cast one listed spell with Charisma and no Material components. Spell save DC 17.
At will. Detect Evil and Good, Shapechange (only Beast or Humanoid forms. The spell grants no Temporary Hit Points, and maintaining it requires neither Temporary Hit Points nor Concentration).
1/day each. Commune, Raise Dead.
sections.Bonus actions: Divine Aid (2/day total). Cast Cure Wounds, Lesser Restoration, or Remove Curse using Charisma, as in Spellcasting.

statBlock.name: Planetar
statBlock.description: A celestial champion whose sword carries radiant power. It recognizes lies and can call down bursts of holy light.

sections.Traits:
Divine Awareness. The angel recognizes a lie when it hears one.
Exalted Restoration. If the angel dies away from Mount Celestia, its body vanishes and it immediately returns at full HP in a new body somewhere on Mount Celestia.
Magic Resistance. Roll saving throws against spells and other magical effects with Advantage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Radiant Sword attacks or use Holy Burst twice.
Radiant Sword. Melee attack, +12 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 14 (2d6 + 7) slashing damage plus 18 (4d8) radiant damage.
Holy Burst. Choose a visible point within 120 ft. Each enemy in a 20-ft.-radius Sphere centered there makes a DC 20 Dexterity save. Failure deals 24 (7d6) radiant damage. Success halves it.
sections.Spellcasting:
Spellcasting. As an action, cast one listed spell with Charisma and no Material components. Spell save DC 20.
At will. Detect Evil and Good.
1/day each. Commune, Control Weather, Dispel Evil and Good, Raise Dead.
sections.Bonus actions: Divine Aid (2/day total). Cast Cure Wounds, Invisibility, Lesser Restoration, or Remove Curse using Charisma, as in Spellcasting.

statBlock.name: Solar
statBlock.description: A celestial commander that can lead angelic hosts or restore a fallen mortal to life to enlist their aid.

sections.Traits:
Divine Awareness. The angel recognizes a lie when it hears one.
Exalted Restoration. If the angel dies away from Mount Celestia, its body vanishes and it immediately returns at full HP in a new body somewhere on Mount Celestia.
Legendary Resistance (4/day). Turn a failed saving throw into a success.
Magic Resistance. Roll saving throws against spells and other magical effects with Advantage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Flying Sword attacks. The solar can replace one of those attacks with Slaying Bow.
Flying Sword. Melee or ranged attack, +15 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 120 ft. A hit deals 22 (4d6 + 8) slashing damage plus 36 (8d8) radiant damage. After a ranged attack, the sword immediately returns by magic to the solar's hand or hovers within 5 ft. of it.
Slaying Bow. One visible creature within 600 ft. makes a DC 21 Dexterity save. A creature that fails dies if it has 100 HP or fewer. A creature with more than 100 HP that fails takes 24 (4d8 + 6) piercing damage plus 36 (8d8) radiant damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
Spellcasting. As an action, cast one listed spell with Charisma and no Material components. Spell save DC 25.
At will. Detect Evil and Good.
1/day each. Commune, Control Weather, Dispel Evil and Good, Resurrection.
sections.Bonus actions: Divine Aid (3/day total). Cast Cure Wounds at level 2, Lesser Restoration, or Remove Curse using Charisma, as in Spellcasting.
sections.Legendary actions:
3 uses. Spend one use immediately after another creature's turn. Recover all uses at the start of the solar's turn. The solar cannot use these actions while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act.
Blinding Gaze. One creature the solar can see within 120 ft. makes a DC 25 Constitution save. Failure leaves it Blinded for 1 minute. The solar cannot use this option again until the start of its next turn, regardless of the result.
Radiant Teleport. The solar teleports up to 60 ft. to a visible unoccupied space. Each creature in the 10-ft. Emanation from the solar's destination makes a DC 25 Dexterity save. Failure deals 11 (2d10) radiant damage. Success halves it.
